name: The Empty Seat
about: The succession at Dun Rìerdan, laid over the canon's city in every world: placed in the country its seat makes the city of (data/imbar/shape.json's seats, `goings`), its ward the city itself and its square the city's heart, never a city of its own (doc/adventures/theemptyseat/friction.md, ES-F01). The standalone proof binds the same modules to a stand-in (data/campaigns/theemptyseat.campaign.json).
